u6_closure_verdict.original_claim: ZEB1-high glioblastoma / NSCLC brain metastasis synthetic lethality with ITGAV (Cilengitide target): Delta = -0.72, FDR = 0.001
u6_closure_verdict.summary_statement: caspro U6 (Δ = -0.72, FDR = 0.001) is REPRODUCED in NSCLC (n=95: ZEB1 -> ITGAV rho = -0.6238, p = 1.45e-11, Tertile ΔChronos = -0.7341, Quartile ΔChronos = -0.7650), FALSIFIED for single-gene ZEB1 in GBM (n=45: rho = +0.0846, p = 0.5806, Tertile Δ = +0.0358), and RESCUED in GBM/CNS by Two-Door S_sen & H_clean (GBM S_sen -> ITGAV rho = -0.3415, p = 0.0217, Δ = -0.3638; GBM S_sen -> ITGB5 rho = -0.3657, p = 0.0135; GBM H_clean -> FERMT2 rho = -0.4839, p = 0.00076, Δ = -0.6546; GBM H_clean -> PTK2 rho = -0.4094, p = 0.0052, Δ = -0.5382; CNS H_clean -> ITGAV rho = -0.3594, p = 0.0011, q = 0.0056; CNS H_clean -> ITGB5 rho = -0.3724, p = 0.0007, q = 0.0047).

falsified_for_single_gene_zeb1_in_gbm.biological_explanation: GBM cell lines are constitutively ITGAV-dependent (mean Chronos = -0.91) and single-gene ZEB1 acts as a neural/proneural transcription factor in bulk/snRNA GBM (GLASS n=123 ZEB1 delta = -0.3396, p = 0.000184; correlating with SOX2 rho = +0.6807 and CHEK1 Chronos rho = -0.523, p = 0.0002), whereas ZEB1 still predicts intracellular focal-adhesion adapters FERMT2 (rho = -0.418, p = 0.0043, Δ = -0.568) and PTK2 (rho = -0.303, p = 0.0434, Δ = -0.354).

evidence.summary: Universally resistant (positive rho(LN_IC50) / higher IC50) in high S_sen / H_clean hibernating GBM and NSCLC lines due to mitotic/replication arrest.

NSCLC_S_sen_high.verdict: RESISTANT — S_sen-high solid tumor/BrM cells depend on BCL-xL (BCL2L1), NOT BCL-2
RESISTANT — S_sen formula subtracts z(MCL1), so high S_sen lines have low MCL1 and high BCL2L1 dependency
